programs.title: The Battle Of Britain (1969)
programs.desc: A stellar cast, including Michael Caine, Laurence Olivier and Christopher Plummer highlights this epic telling of the greatest air battle in history, when the outnumbered Royal Air Force defeated the German Luftwaffe, saving England from invasion.

programs.title: A Bridge Too Far
programs.desc: With an all-star cast that includes Sean Connery, Anthony Hopkins, Laurence Olivier, Gene Hackman and Robert Redford, this epic WW II drama recreates Operation Market Garden, an ambitious plan to hasten the end of WW II that ended in disaster.

programs.title: Black Mama, White Mama
programs.desc: A tough prostitute (Pam Grier) and a revolutionary (Margaret Markov) are admitted to a tough women’s prison where almost immediately they clash.

programs.title: Coffy
programs.desc: Pam Grier stars as Nurse "Coffy" Coffin, a one-woman vigilante force, out to even the score with those who have hooked her sister on drugs. Using her feminine wiles and deadly weapons, Coffy sets about ridding the streets of society's scum.

programs.title: Foxy Brown
programs.desc: Pam Grier portrays one of the screen's first action heroines with humor, sensitivity and steely determination. This electrifying revenge thriller explodes with all the sex appeal and cooler-than-cool attitude of its irresistible leading lady.

programs.title: The Thomas Crown Affair (1968)
programs.desc: Sophisticated, handsome Thomas Crown (Steve McQueen) is the intellect behind a bank robbery so stunning, it has Boston's finest completely baffled.  Faye Dunaway is the sleek and smart insurance investigator out to bring him in.
